observations: A single headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic film.
The assembly has a black internal housing and a clear outer lens.
An amber/yellow reflector is visible on the side/top edge.
The item is resting on a rough concrete or dirt surface.
A watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA' is overlaid on the image.
The plastic wrap obscures fine details of the lens surface.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension parts for all model of honda, acura n toyota
claims.evidence: This is a general business statement and cannot be verified for a specific inventory from one photo.

risks.risk: Broken or missing mounting tabs on the rear of the housing
risks.proof: Photo of the back/rear side of the headlight assembly.
risks.if_unproven: as having broken tabs requiring repair

risks.risk: Scratches, cracks, or hazing on the lens hidden by the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Clear photo of the lens with the plastic wrap removed.
risks.if_unproven: as having a heavily scratched or damaged lens

risks.risk: Non-functional internal components (LEDs, projectors, or bulbs)
risks.proof: Video showing the headlight fully powered and illuminated.

risks.risk: Incorrect vehicle fitment (unknown year and model)
risks.proof: Manufacturer part number sticker or seller confirmation of the specific car model and year.

proof_requests: State the exact car model and year this headlight fits.
Provide a photo of the back of the headlight to inspect the mounting points.
Provide a photo of the headlight without the plastic wrapping.

response.reason: The specific vehicle model and year are not identified in the photo or text, and the price of a headlight varies drastically depending on the car it fits.
